input: Reserve a campsite for the long weekend getaway

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The specific long weekend (dates) determines availability windows and booking urgency — some campsites fill up months in advance.
The destination or region narrows which campground platforms, parks, or sites to search, and affects travel logistics entirely.
Group size and composition (adults, kids, pets) determines the site type needed and how many spots to reserve.
Camping style (tent, RV, glamping cabin) dictates what kind of campsite to look for and the amenities required.
Budget per night shapes which campgrounds and site types are realistic options.
Whether the user already has a campground in mind vs. needs recommendations changes the first action — searching vs. booking directly.
Knowing the must-have features (hookups, lake access, hiking trails, privacy) defines what a good reservation actually looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Reserve a campsite for the long weekend
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book a campsite for an upcoming long weekend trip, but key details about location, group, dates, and preferences are needed to make the right reservation.

questions.title: Which long weekend are you targeting for this trip?
questions.description: Identify the specific dates or holiday weekend (e.g., Memorial Day, Labor Day, July 4th) to determine booking urgency and availability.

questions.title: What general region or destination do you have in mind?
questions.description: Pinpoint the geographic area — state, national park, or specific campground — to know where to search or book.

questions.title: How many people are coming, and are any kids or pets joining?
questions.description: Determine group size and composition to select the right site size and filter for pet-friendly or family-friendly options.

questions.title: Will you be tent camping, using an RV, or staying in a cabin?
questions.description: Identify the camping style to filter for appropriate site types and required hookups or structures.

questions.title: What is your budget per night for the campsite?
questions.description: Establish a nightly price range to focus the search on realistic and affordable options.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific campground in mind to book?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs help researching campgrounds or is ready to go straight to booking a known site.

questions.title: What site features matter most to you for this trip?
questions.description: Identify must-have amenities or attributes — such as waterfront access, electrical hookups, shower facilities, or trail proximity — that define a successful reservation.
